title: Wiki Style Guide/Fruit Tree
wikitext:
''Instructions: When reusing this code, remove all nowiki tags.'' {{Tree Infobox |title = Tree |image = Tree Stage 5 Fruit |Sapling = Tree Sapling |Produce = Fruit |Growth Time = 28 days |Season = {{Season|Fall}} |Sell Price = 5000 |gPrice = {{GS Price|sapling|1500}} |tPrice = 2500 }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a type of [[Trees|Fruit Tree]]. It takes 28 days to grow to maturity, after which it will produce [[item name]] each day during {{Season|Fall}}. It can only grow in the center of a 3x3 square, each square of which must be kept completely clear of objects, flooring, and terrain features (including grass). The 3x3 grid must not overlap the 3x3 grid of another Fruit Tree. For each full year after maturing, fruit trees will produce higher quality fruit, up to iridium star quality after three years. Note that the 3x3 square around the tree doesn't have to be kept clear once the tree has fully grown. If struck by lightning during a [[Stardew:Weather#Storm|thunderstorm]], a fruit tree will produce [[Stardew:Coal|Coal]] for 4 days instead of fruit. Fruit trees can be planted in the [[Stardew:Greenhouse|Greenhouse]]. ==Stages==
